cases.title: Initial render of the Online Quiz Portal
cases.description: Verify that when the user accesses the Online Quiz Portal webpage, the system displays an h1 element with the text 'Online Quiz Portal', an h2 element with the text 'What is the capital of France?' (data-testid: 'question'), a div (data-testid: 'options') containing four radio button options ('Berlin', 'Madrid', 'Paris', 'Lisbon', each with type 'radio', name 'option', and respective data-testids 'option-0' to 'option-3'), and a button labeled 'Next Question' (data-testid: 'next-button').

cases.title: Sequential question text updates upon clicking Next
cases.description: Verify that the question text updates correctly across clicks on the 'Next Question' button, starting with 'What is the capital of France?', changing to 'What is 2 + 2?' on the first click, and 'What is the largest ocean on Earth?' on the second click.

cases.title: Dynamic generation of answer options
cases.description: Verify that the system dynamically generates answer options as radio buttons inside the options div based on the current question data, each with a unique value matching the option text and a shared name 'option'.

cases.title: Radio button single selection and data-testids
cases.description: Verify that no option is selected by default, each radio button has a unique data-testid in the format 'option-{index}', and clicking an option selects it while clearing any previous selection.

cases.title: Scoring logic and state progression
cases.description: Verify that selecting a correct option increments the score by 1 upon clicking 'Next Question', while skipping or selecting incorrectly proceeds without incrementing the score.

cases.title: Quiz completion and final score display
cases.description: Verify that after answering or skipping the final question, clicking 'Next Question' hides the question, options, and next-button elements (by adding the 'hidden' class) and displays the final score in the score div with the text 'You scored X out of Y'.

opinions.feedback: All high-level cases are distinct, fully testable, and accurately map to the provided requirements without any blockers.
All test cases are well-structured, clear, and accurately map to the provided requirements. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes verifying initial DOM elements (h1 'Online Quiz Portal', h2 'What is the capital of France?' with data-testid 'question', div with data-testid 'options', 4 radio buttons with name 'option' and data-testids 'option-0' to 'option-3', and button 'Next Question' with data-testid 'next-button'). Boundaries include exactly 4 options. Normal path is correct initial render; abnormal path is missing elements. Ambiguity: whether radio inputs have explicit labels linked via 'for' or wrapping. R-2: Testable behavior includes question text progression across clicks ('What is the capital of France?' -> 'What is 2 + 2?' -> 'What is the largest ocean on Earth?'). Boundaries include sequence length (3 questions). Normal path is sequential click progression; abnormal path is out-of-bounds clicks. Ambiguity: behavior when clicking next beyond the last question. R-3: Testable behavior includes dynamic generation of options based on quizData array with unique values and shared name 'option'. Normal path is correct mapping; abnormal path is empty or malformed quizData. R-4: Testable behavior includes single-select radio button behavior, no default selection, correct data-testids ('option-{index}'), and clearing previous selections. Normal path is selecting an option; abnormal path is selecting multiple simultaneously (which should be prevented by shared name 'option'). R-5: Testable behavior includes scoring logic (+1 for correct, 0 for incorrect/skipped), advancing state, and transitioning to final view (hiding question, options, next-button by adding 'hidden' class and showing score div with 'You scored {score} out of {total}'). Normal path is selecting correct answer and proceeding; abnormal path is skipping without selection or selecting incorrect answer. Ambiguity: does incorrect answer increment score? (Requirement states 'if correct, it increments the score by 1; if not selected, it proceeds without scoring', but needs clarification for incorrect non-selected vs incorrect selected options). R-6: Testable behavior confirms completion states: hiding 'question', 'options', 'next-button' and displaying 'score' with 'You scored X out of Y' format after the final question. Normal path is reaching end and viewing score; abnormal path is premature triggering of end state.
